Do not invent a different pip style.

Keep a clear ivory gap around every edge of the emblem. Large lavish emblem occupying most of available central width, about60% of total card width. No people, clothing, weapons, sash or separate central jewel.
Only two corner indices, each a large serif A above a small solid suit symbol. Upper-left upright, lower-right same index rotated180degrees. Single central emblem upright, NOT doubled into opposing symbols. No other text, logo, tax stamp, ribbon, signature, watermark or mockup. Use reference2's club with its gold-beaded border, teal foliage, red/ivory lotus rosette and turquoise jewel. Enlarge to most of available central ivory width, about60% of total card width and52% of card height, maintaining natural club proportions. Jewel centered at full canvas center. Both A letters and small solid corner CLUB symbols are BLACK. Keep the outermost frame band BLACK and all interior floral fields BLACK. Keep frame boundaries and cartouche positions unchanged. Remove every spade symbol from the reference.
